# source: fancyvrb manual (v4.5c, 2024/01/20): the Verbatim environment with its options,
# \DefineVerbatimEnvironment deriving one from it, the variants BVerbatim and LVerbatim, \fvset
# for defaults, \VerbatimInput and \Verb. Verbatim and a derived environment set their body as
# minted's text block with fontsize, tabsize, numbers and xleftmargin read; another key is named.
# The variants, the defaults, file input and inline \Verb are named as unread.
body impl \begin{Verbatim} x = 1 \end{Verbatim}
body impl \begin{Verbatim}[xleftmargin=2em] x = 1 \end{Verbatim}
pre impl \DefineVerbatimEnvironment{Code}{Verbatim}{fontsize=\small}\AtBeginDocument{\begin{Code} x \end{Code}}
body refuse:W0302 \begin{BVerbatim} x \end{BVerbatim}
body refuse:W0302 \begin{LVerbatim} x \end{LVerbatim}
pre refuse:W0301 \fvset{fontsize=\small}
body refuse:W0301 \VerbatimInput{fixtures/example.py}
body refuse:W0301 \Verb|x|
